audience: marketing teams that manage contacts and campaigns in Smoove

useCases.title: Look up a contact and its fields
useCases.text: List the contact field keys of the account, then look up a contact by id, email or cell phone. Check whether a contact exists.

useCases.title: List the contacts in a list
useCases.text: List the contact lists of the account, then the contacts that belong to one list.

useCases.title: Check unsubscribes before a send
useCases.text: List the contacts who unsubscribed, with the time and reason, before you plan a new send.

useCases.title: Review a campaign's results
useCases.text: Read the sent, opened, clicked and unsubscribed counts of one campaign. List the landing pages and sign-up forms.

useCases.title: Add a contact or unsubscribe one
useCases.text: Create a contact, or update it when a match exists. Set the opt-in flag only when the person opted in.
